title: Wood trusses for roof assemblies in Part 9 buildings: professional involvement (current R1)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: May 2025 (platform created May 28, 2025, last updated May 28, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the requirement for professional involvement in the design of wood trusses for roof assemblies used in Part 9 buildings.
A truss assembly constructed using wood trusses must be designed by a registered engineering professional, including, where applicable, the way trusses are interconnected.
Authentication does not have to occur on the roof truss layout plan if the interconnection information is provided in a separate authenticated document.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
The February 2025 original (23-BCI-015) is superseded and kept as a reference.

Status (Feb 2026 implementation notice, attached as supporting evidence): 23-BCI-015R1 applies to one- and two-family dwellings from 1 March 2026, and 23-BCB-002R1 is archived as of 28 February 2026. The Nov 2025 notice (catalogue label SUPERSEDED) described both as in effect at that time.
